## History

After [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finished painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovered that it had been painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) were initially devastated by the mistake, the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) rallied in sympathy and support for them against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P15](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0015), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
